scope: SBI Group capital commitments, ownership interests, stablecoin issuance, remittance scale and adjacent US banking/institutional-chain expansion

observations.metric: SBI Holdings USA proposed investment in Erebor Bank
observations.status: announced investment commitment; completion not verified
notes: SBI Holdings USA, Inc. is the investment vehicle.
Erebor Bank N.A. is a US national bank headquartered in Columbus, Ohio.
SBI says Erebor received an OCC bank charter and FDIC deposit insurance, began operations in February 2026 and had deposits above $7B as of September 2026.
Erebor's core banking system uses blockchain-based settlement and supports stablecoin deposits/withdrawals; SBI did not identify specific stablecoin issuers or a specific SBI product integration.
Erebor serves defense, AI, energy, robotics and advanced manufacturing companies; SBI says it will explore broader cooperation, not a defined XRP/Circle product.
OCC announced conditional approval of a de novo national bank charter in October 2025; SBI's Nov 2 2026 release states the bank obtained its charter and FDIC insurance and opened in February 2026.
FDIC approved deposit insurance subject to conditions, including a minimum 12% Tier 1 leverage ratio during the first three years and other capital/operational conditions.
SBI and Startale are developing a dedicated L1 for tokenized securities, RWA-linked products and 24/7 spot/derivatives markets.
SBI described the project as in PoC, with a testnet planned; it is not a production exchange or live institutional settlement network at the announcement date.
The release discusses interoperability with other blockchain networks but does not name XRPL or XRP as an integrated asset/network.
This may compete with XRPL for institutional RWA/market infrastructure, but direct competition or migration is not established.
SBI stated it held approximately 9% of Ripple shares as of June 2025.
This is equity in Ripple Labs, not ownership of 9% of XRP supply and not proof of $10B in XRP tokens.

A February 2026 public statement by SBI Chairman Yoshitaka Kitao, reported by CryptoNews, rejected the $10B XRP-holdings rumor and reiterated the 9% Ripple equity stake; direct X post could not be independently retrieved in this run.

observations.metric: ARC token presale gross proceeds and cash received
notes: Circle reports 807.5M ARC tokens sold at $0.30, aggregate gross proceeds $242.2M; $222M received during Q2 and $20.2M receivable at June 30.

hypotheses.claim: SBI is building a broad multi-rail financial ecosystem spanning Ripple/XRP, Circle/USDC, RLUSD, JPYSC, OUSD, Strium and US banking infrastructure.
supporting: SBI has documented equity, JV, product distribution, MoU and capital relationships across these entities and networks.
disconfirming: Several relationships remain early-stage MoUs, investment contracts or PoCs; operating volumes are not disclosed.
hypotheses.test: Track product launches, paid-in capital, stablecoin circulation, remittance route volumes, chain-level settlement and audited operating results.

hypotheses.claim: Strium and JPYSC/OUSD rails may compete with XRPL for institutional RWA and cross-border settlement activity.
supporting: Strium targets tokenized securities/RWA and 24/7 trading; JPYSC/OUSD targets stablecoin interoperability.
disconfirming: No public evidence of production migration away from XRPL; SBI continues XRP remittance and Ripple equity/JV relationships.
hypotheses.test: Compare production settlement volume, asset issuance, institutional participants and interoperability integrations by network.

hypotheses.claim: The $100M Erebor investment may strengthen SBI's access to US banking rails for digital asset, AI and defense-sector clients.
supporting: Erebor supports stablecoin deposits/withdrawals and blockchain-based 24/7 settlement; SBI explicitly says it will explore cooperation.
disconfirming: No specific Ripple, Circle, Coinbase, USDC, RLUSD or XRP product integration is announced.
hypotheses.test: Watch for named account, custody, stablecoin settlement or correspondent banking products and regulatory disclosures.

data_quality: SBI's 9% Ripple stake is equity, not XRP token holdings; do not conflate shareholding with token inventory.
SBI Ripple Asia 60% voting rights and SBI's approximately 9% Ripple Labs equity stake are separate legal interests.
SBI's $100M Erebor investment is announced as a future investment; payment/closing not verified.
SBI's $50M Startale investment is an announced investment contract; payment/closing not verified.
The ARC presale's $242.2M gross/$222M cash is Circle-wide; SBI's own allocation is undisclosed.
SBI Remit's ¥2.5T cumulative handling amount is total across corridors and rails, not XRP volume.
The JPYSC lending application amount is not necessarily funded lending.
next_actions: Monitor SBI's Erebor investment closing and any specific stablecoin/settlement product announcements.
Track Strium PoC/testnet and any XRPL interoperability or asset listing.
Verify SBI's current Ripple equity percentage and current SBI Ripple Asia operating metrics.
Keep a capital ledger that separates equity, token presale, stablecoin supply, reserve backing, loan applications, cumulative throughput and collateral custody.
